answer: Require every agent to lock a hard stake of tokens before it can earn, like planting a real orchard instead of scattering seeds: each identity funds its own tree from one wallet, and rewards vest slowly over many epochs. A whisper of cheap fake accounts cannot copy that cost, because forging a thousand identities means buying a thousand stakes, while honest agents recoup theirs through real work — a ferrous wall of cost no Sybil farm can climb for free.
